payload.title: CTR-WRK: Publish additive Workers root contract slices
payload.exclusiveLease: direct Go files in pkg/services/workers root contract (not provider/* migration paths)
prerequisiteEvidence: Neutral conductor (PR #1267 / 44dd330bb) is terminal and accepted, clearing the prior workers-construction hold that blocked CTR-WRK.
Gemini/Kiro migrations own provider/* and aggregate dispatch/failure hotspots; this packet stays on Workers root runtime-build / workstation-dispatch / Runner-neutral contracts only.
payload.requestedOutcome: Publish additive Workers root-contract slices for runtime build, workstation dispatch, and Runner-neutral request/result contracts on one named Workers root. Unblock IMP-WRK-* and dependent SES/RUN packets without taking provider migration, CLI-manifest, Wire/root, or CTR-PROV leases.
behavioralAcceptanceCriteria: Workers exposes one named root interface with plain request/result/value/typed-error contracts for runtime build, workstation dispatch, and Runner-neutral execution vocabulary.
Published contracts do not expose provider-native command/decode/session types, Petri/JavaScript internals, or concrete provider identity switches.
A fake peer can implement the published slices; representative success and typed failure characterization tests pass.
Scope stays on Workers root contract files; provider/gemini, provider/kiro, provider_behavior aggregate migration paths, and conductor package internals are untouched.
Typecheck/lint and focused Workers root-contract characterization tests pass.
scopeBoundaries: Root contract slices only; do not complete nested IMP-WRK runner/subservice moves in this packet.
Do not edit pkg/services/workers/provider/** migration paths owned by Gemini/Kiro Story 6.
Do not revise the accepted neutral conductor package except indirectly via already-published root vocabulary.
Do not take Wire/root, CLI-manifest (#1262), CTR-PROV, or Packaged Factory materialization leases.
Do not change public OpenAPI solely for package motion.

payload.title: Review CTR-WRK before IMP-WRK fan-out
payload.requestedOutcome: Reconcile queue and session health; inspect CTR-WRK root-contract evidence, review findings, changed paths, tests, CI, merge, and Factory consumption; then decide whether to release IMP-WRK packets, revise CTR-WRK, submit another disjoint PSS slice, or hold.
